name: WebAdish AutoSheets for Google Sheets
author: Dilip Parmar

sections.description:
WebAdish AutoSheets automatically sends every form submission from your WordPress site directly to Google Sheets. Setup once, works forever.

Free version includes Contact Form 7 support. Upgrade to Pro for WPForms, Gravity Forms, Formidable, and more.

Key Features

✓ One-Time Setup – Configure once, works for ALL forms forever
✓ Auto-Creates Sheets – Each form gets its own tab automatically
✓ Auto-Generates Headers – Column headers created from your form fields
✓ Non-Blocking – Forms submit instantly, no waiting
✓ One-Time Payment – Unlike Zapier (₹1,500-2,500/month)
✓ No API Limits – Google Apps Script has no request limits
✓ Activity Log – Track all submissions
✓ Privacy Focused – Data goes directly to your Google account

Supported Form Plugins

Free Version:
* Contact Form 7

Pro Version ($29 one-time):
* WPForms (Lite & Pro)
* Gravity Forms
* Formidable Forms
* Ninja Forms
* Elementor Forms
* Fluent Forms

Pro Pricing – One-Time Payment

₹2,499 ($29) – Single Site
* All form plugins (Gravity Forms, Formidable, Ninja Forms, Elementor Forms)
* Multiple spreadsheets with routing
* Field mapping
* Conditional logic
* Priority support
* Lifetime updates

₹4,999 ($59) – 5 Sites
* Everything in Single Site
* Use on 5 websites

₹9,999 ($99) – Unlimited Sites
* Everything in Single Site
* Unlimited websites
* White-label option

View Pro Features →

How It Works

  1. Create a Google Spreadsheet
  2. Add our Google Apps Script code (provided)
  3. Paste the script URL in settings
  4. Done! All forms sync automatically

Why Choose WebAdish AutoSheets?

vs Zapier:
* Zapier: ₹1,500-2,500/month, 100-750 task limit, manual per-form setup
* WebAdish AutoSheets: ₹2,499 one-time, unlimited, automatic setup

vs Other Plugins:
* Most: Recurring fees, limited forms, manual setup
* WebAdish AutoSheets: One-time fee, all forms, zero config

Documentation

  • Setup Guide
  • Support

Privacy Policy

WebAdish AutoSheets does not collect or store any data. Form submissions go directly from your WordPress site to your Google account.

Local storage (in WordPress database):
* Google Apps Script URL
* Activity log (last 50 entries)
* Monthly count (free version)

Credits

Developed by Dilip Parmar
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “WebAdish AutoSheets”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate”
  5. Go to WebAdish AutoSheets → Setup Guide
  6. Follow the 4-step setup (5 minutes)
sections.faq:
Does this work with my form plugin?

Free: Contact Form 7 only
Pro: WPForms, Gravity Forms, Formidable Forms, Ninja Forms, Elementor Forms, Fluent Forms

How many submissions?

Unlimited submissions for all users.

Is it really one-time payment?

Yes! No monthly fees. Pay once, use forever.

Do I need a Google account?

Yes, a free Google account is required.

Does this slow down forms?

No! Forms submit instantly (non-blocking).

Is my data secure?

Yes! Data goes directly to YOUR Google account. We never see it.

Can I use different spreadsheets?

Free: One spreadsheet, different tabs per form
Pro: Multiple spreadsheets with routing

What’s included in Pro?

  • All form plugins (Gravity Forms, Formidable, Ninja Forms, Elementor Forms)
  • Multiple spreadsheets with routing
  • Field mapping
  • Conditional logic
  • Priority 24hr support
  • Lifetime updates

30-day money-back guarantee?

Yes! No questions asked refund within 30 days.
